Default content:
Do you want to create, but get stuck on how to begin?
Or do you miss the joy of creating you once had?

Your Creative Space is a coaching package for you who long to reconnect with your creative side in a safe and pressure-free environment.

Perhaps creativity has taken a back seat in a life full of responsibilities. Perhaps the longing is there, but self-criticism or uncertainty takes over. Here you get a calm space where creation is not about performance, but about curiosity, presence and desire.

Together we explore what awakens your creativity right now. You get support to find your own expression, get started with concrete steps and let creation become a natural and meaningful part of everyday life.

I serve as a sounding board, mentor and cheerleader in your process.

This package is for you who

  • want to get started with creating but don't know how to begin
  • long for more creativity in life
  • want to find your way back to the joy of creating
  • are looking for a safe space to explore your expression
  • want to give creativity a clear place in your everyday life
  • are in a phase of life where there is a bit more room for yourself
  • want to use your time for something that feels meaningful and creative, something that is just for you

Perhaps you are in a phase of life where a bit more space has opened up for yourself. The children are older, everyday life looks different, and there is a longing to fill that time with something that feels meaningful, something that is not about responsibility or performance, but just about you and your creation.

How does it work?

My coaching consists of conversations, and my experience is that most people need at least three sessions to get an accurate picture of what the coaching can offer and feel comfortable in the process. The sessions are 60 minutes long.

The first session

Explores your current situation, your longings and how I can support you going forward. You get help formulating goals, gaining new perspectives on your creation and already here tools to get started.

After each session you receive a written summary and inspiring homework, practical, creative or reflective, that keeps your work developing between meetings. We end each session with a brief summary and a plan for what you want to focus on until next time.

All material is sent to you, so that you have your process documented, a personal tool you can return to whenever you want.

You don't need to prepare for the first session, but if you reflect a little on what you want to get out of the coaching before we meet, we can use the time even more effectively.

My starting point

I believe in creation as a human necessity, not a performance.
I believe in hands as thinking organs.
And in the power of working with materials, time and curiosity.

This is not a path to becoming something.
It is an opportunity to come closer to what is already there.

Over three months you get

  • 3 coaching sessions (1 per month, 60 minutes) via video
  • Written summary after each session
  • Inspiring homework that helps you keep creation alive between our meetings

The homework is simple and joy-based, small steps that help you explore materials, ideas and your personal expression without demands for performance.

Price
SEK 1,750 / month
3 months – total SEK 5,250

Perhaps there is a clear vision inside you, but you're stuck on how to actually make it happen.

Here you get support throughout the entire process: from artistic guidance and idea development to practical advice on materials, techniques and methods to carry out your project.

Perhaps you have carried your idea for a long time. Perhaps you have started something, but got stuck in doubt, perfectionism or overwhelming possibilities. It's easy to stay in the abstract, in thoughts and plans without really stepping into the doing.

Here you get a context where your idea can land in the physical. We work with both artistic perspectives and practical tools, so that ideas can be turned into real forms, materials and expressions.

  • want to take your creation seriously and see what it can become
  • want support in both artistic decisions and practical implementation

  • easily get stuck in self-criticism, doubt or perfectionism
  • long to give your inner world an outer expression

How does it work?

My coaching consists of conversations, and my experience is that most people need at least three sessions to get an accurate picture of what the coaching can offer and feel comfortable in the process. The sessions are 60 minutes long.

The first session

After each session you receive a written summary and inspiring, action-based homework – tailored to you, your project and your material choices – that help you continue working between our meetings. We end each session with a clear direction for the next step.

My starting point

I believe that ideas live in the body as much as in the mind.
I believe in hands as a way to understand.
And that creation needs both direction, freedom and concrete tools to grow.

This is not about making something perfect.
It's about letting something come into being.

Over three months you get

  • 3 coaching sessions (1 per month, 60 minutes) via video
  • Written summary after each session
  • Inspiring and concrete homework that moves your creation forward between our meetings, including support for material choices and techniques

The homework helps you work with your idea in practice – through materials, sketches, reflection and action – in small steps that make the process alive and possible.

Translated content: Jag möter människor i alla åldrar och faser av livet. Här är några exempel på klienter jag arbetar med.

Default content: No matter where you are in life – I'm here for you.
Translated content: Oavsett var du befinner dig i livet – jag finns här för dig.

Default content: You're longing to make room for your creativity, perhaps for the first time in a long while, and want to fill your free time with something that brings extra meaning. Here, you'll find support to discover your expression, create without pressure, and let the process become a source of joy.
Translated content: Du längtar efter att ge plats åt din kreativitet, kanske för första gången på länge, och vill fylla din fritid med något som ger extra mening. Här får du stöd att hitta ditt uttryck, skapa utan krav och låta processen bli en källa till glädje.

Default content: You know you have something to say, but need help shaping your artistic idea. Together, we work on expression, portfolio, applications, or projects and build trust in your inner drive.
Translated content: Du vet att du har något att säga, men behöver hjälp att forma din konstnärliga idé. Tillsammans arbetar vi med uttryck, portfölj, ansökningar eller projekt och bygger tillit till din inre drivkraft.

Default content: You are already creating – in wood, paint, fabric, or words – but want to understand more and develop further. Here, you will receive feedback, tips, and new perspectives that will help you take your creativity to the next level.
Translated content: Du skapar redan – i trä, färg, tyg eller ord – men vill förstå mer och utvecklas vidare. Här får du feedback, tips och nya perspektiv som hjälper dig att ta ditt skapande till nästa nivå.

Default content: You've always been busy with work and everyday life. Now you feel a stronger urge to make space for creativity – as a place of your own, separate from daily obligations.
Translated content: Du har alltid haft fullt upp med jobb och vardag. Nu känner du allt starkare att du vill ge utrymme åt kreativiteten – som en egen plats utanför vardagens måsten.

Default content: What do you long for in your creative work?
Translated content: Vad längtar du efter i ditt skapande?

Default content: Do you recognize yourself in any of this?
Translated content: Känner du igen dig i något av detta?

Default content: You don't need to know where to begin – we'll explore it together.
Translated content: Du behöver inte veta var du ska börja – vi utforskar det tillsammans.

Default content: Have you been carrying ideas that have been waiting to come to life?
Translated content: Har du länge burit på idéer som väntat på att få liv?

Default content: Stuck in performance, self-criticism or uncertainty about your direction?
Translated content: Fastnat i prestation, självkritik eller osäkerhet kring din riktning?

Default content: Longing to make space for your creativity – perhaps for the first time in a long time?
Translated content: Längtar efter att ge plats åt din kreativitet – kanske för första gången på länge?

Default content: Seeking inspiration and guidance to take the next step?
Translated content: Söker inspiration och vägledning för att ta nästa steg?

Default content: Ready to start your creative journey?
Translated content: Redo att börja din kreativa resa?

Default content: Take the first step towards a more creative life. Book a free 15-minute consultation where we talk about your dreams, goals, and how I can support you.
Translated content: Ta första steget mot ett mer kreativt liv. Boka en kostnadsfri 15-minuters konsultation där vi pratar om dina drömmar, mål och hur jag kan stötta dig.
